In this episode of The Lallantop's Mukhyamantri, a special series of political stories, Editor Saurabh Dwivedi will tell the story of the first Chief Minister of Bihar. This is the story of a boy who did not open the window of his hostel to remain unseen by George V who was visiting Patna. The story of a leader who was influenced by the personality of both the leaders Nehru and Patel. This is the story of Shri Krishna Singh, the person who served the longest period of time as the Chief Minister of Bihar. Watch the video for more details.
